title: Kanban board horizontal scroll jumps to the left periodically
description:
The web app kanban board periodically shifts all the way to the left in terms of horizontal scrolling. If the Backlog column is not visible, it briefly scrolls into view and then returns to where it was. It may happen on a timer by itself, or when realtime updates arrive from workers; the trigger is not yet known.

Expected: the board's horizontal scroll position is never changed by background refreshes, realtime events or snapshot updates; only user action moves it.

Acceptance: reproduce the trigger (idle timer versus realtime worker events), add a Gherkin scenario in features/console that scrolls the board horizontally, delivers a realtime update, and asserts the scroll position is unchanged, then fix it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in PR #375. Root cause: the card-move animation (GSAP Flip) adds is-flipping to the board scroller, and kanban.css forced overflow: visible on it, so the scroller stopped scrolling and scrollLeft reset to 0 for the 0.4s animation on every realtime update. Fix: .kb-grid.is-flipping keeps overflow-x: auto. Spec features/console/board_horizontal_scroll.feature samples scrollLeft each frame while an issue moves: failed before the fix (756 to 0), passes after, and passes in CI console-ui. Trade-off: cards flying between columns can be clipped at the board's top and bottom edges during the animation.
